title: Redesign UI, add font tools, docs overhaul, admin dashboard
body:
Redesigns the dashboard as a bento grid, rewrites the Font Matcher on the Google Fonts API (discover, pairings, compare and specimen views), restyles the docs pages and the HTML export, and adds an admin dashboard with page analytics and feedback management. Also adds AVIF output to Video to Frames and fixes compression-slider lag in the Image Converter.

**Testing:** Production build (`vite build`) and manual checks of each surface.
